content:
Long before the iPod era, the Sony Walkman was the go-to choice for anyone who wanted to add a soundtrack to their life. Now there's a Duo-Man app that recreates that experience for those of us who once owned one, and you can use it together with Apple Music…

Before the Walkman, if you wanted to listen to music on the go, your options were pretty limited. Most cassette players at the time were heavy and bulky. Sony shrunk a recorder originally designed for journalists into the smallest cassette player around at the time, and it quickly became an iconic product of its generation.

Developer Vidit Bhargava created this app at a hackathon — since many people there had never seen one in person, he even brought along an actual unit to show everyone what it looked like.

You open Duo, pick the album "cassette" you want to insert, then close the lid and the music starts playing.

Bhargava says he originally built this demo app just for fun, but will now officially launch it as a real app. The best reply on the X post is this one — an image that only a certain age group would understand.

What was your first music player? Share with us in the comments.
